description: This file defines the IAsyncBatchObservable interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which allows subscription to batch streams with optional starting tokens.

classes.name: IAsyncBatchObservable
classes.description: An interface for asynchronous batch stream observables that supports subscribing with or without a starting token.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes an observer to the batch observable, returning a handle for managing the subscription.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes an observer to the batch observable starting from a specified stream sequence token.
